operation_states.note: uncertain is the crash-ambiguity state for paid/non-idempotent work

generate_asset.description: Generate a creative asset via AI provider
generate_asset.automatic_recovery: If asset.status == 'ok' when lease expires, the job is automatically recovered to 'succeeded' by recover_expired_jobs(). Otherwise it enters 'uncertain' and requires manual review.
generate_asset.manual_intervention: Inspect the asset record. If the AI provider delivered a result, mark succeeded. If no result exists, cancel and re-enqueue with a new idempotency key.
generate_asset.cost_exposure: One AI generation call per uncertain job

generation.run_item.description: Execute a single generation run item within a batch
generation.run_item.automatic_recovery: Lease expiry recovery checks asset status, same as generate_asset.
generation.run_item.manual_intervention: Check generation run state. Retry only if the AI provider confirms no work was started.
generation.run_item.cost_exposure: One AI generation call per uncertain job

generation.qc_asset_version.description: Quality-check an asset version after generation
generation.qc_asset_version.manual_intervention: Re-run QC manually. QC is a read-only evaluation so cost exposure is limited to the review API call.
generation.qc_asset_version.cost_exposure: One AI review call per uncertain job

launch_canary.description: Canary launch to Meta Ads API
launch_canary.manual_intervention: Check Meta Ads Manager for whether the ad was created. If created, mark succeeded. If not, cancel and re-enqueue. NEVER retry blindly — may create duplicate ads.
launch_canary.cost_exposure: Potential duplicate ad creation if retried without checking
launch_canary.human_gate: META_WRITE_ENABLED must be true (disabled in dev); production Meta write requires manual accreditation

verify_upload_intent.description: Verify a file upload intent was fulfilled
verify_upload_intent.automatic_recovery: Re-queued automatically on lease expiry — verification is idempotent.
verify_upload_intent.manual_intervention: None expected. If stuck in retry loop, check blob store connectivity.

meta_read_ingestion.description: Ingest data from Meta Marketing API (read-only)
meta_read_ingestion.automatic_recovery: Re-queued automatically on lease expiry — ingestion is idempotent (upsert semantics).
meta_read_ingestion.manual_intervention: None expected. If stuck, check Meta API rate limits and token validity.

human_only_gates.description: META_WRITE_ENABLED=false in development. Production Meta write requires manual accreditation and the access token to be set by an operator.
SUPERUSER_DATABASE_URL and role passwords are operator-managed secrets. No automated test uses production credentials.
Jobs in 'uncertain' state after crash require manual inspection of external side effects before resolution. No automated process may resolve uncertain jobs.
